summary: Rocco fetches Norin the Wary, whose constant flickering retriggers ETB pingers, draw, and token engines until the table burns down.

tags.name: etb effects
tags.reason: Every engine card triggers on a creature entering; Norin, Saltskitter, and the token makers exist to fire Impact Tremors, Gala Greeters, Tocasia's Welcome, and the rest as often as possible, with Panharmonicon and Gandalf the White doubling the triggers.

tags.name: pingers
tags.reason: Impact Tremors, Witty Roastmaster, Agate Instigator, Molten Gatekeeper, Arbaaz Mir, and Outpost Siege each drip damage on every entry or exit, and Torbran turns each one-point ping into three; ping attrition is the primary win.

tags.name: burn
tags.reason: The deck's clock is noncombat damage to each opponent every turn of the table, amplified by Torbran, Thane of Red Fell.

tags.name: draw
tags.reason: Mentor of the Meek, Welcoming Vampire, Tocasia's Welcome, Enduring Innocence, Irreverent Gremlin, Rumor Gatherer, Path of Discovery, and Soul of the Harvest all convert the constant small-creature entries into cards.

tags.name: tokens
tags.reason: Genesis Chamber, Blessed Sanctuary, Saradoc, Samwise Gamgee, Gala Greeters, Rose Room Treasurer, and Skyclave Relic produce a steady token stream that retriggers the entry payoffs and fuels an End-Raze Forerunners finish.

tags.name: +1/+1 counters
tags.reason: Champion of Lambholt, Heronblade Elite, Gimli, and Legolas grow with every entry, but the counters are a payoff, not the plan.

tags.name: go-wide
tags.reason: Myr, Halfling, and Unicorn tokens accumulate into a wide board that End-Raze Forerunners turns into a real swing.

tags.name: legends
tags.reason: Norin's re-entries are legendary entries, so Gimli of the Glittering Caves and Legolas Greenleaf grow constantly and Gandalf the White doubles the triggers, but there is no broader legends-matter shell.

tags.name: lifegain
tags.reason: Soul Warden, Essence Warden, Arbaaz Mir, and Gala Greeters gain life on every entry as a defensive cushion.

tags.name: ramp
tags.reason: Thirteen ramp cards, including Heronblade Elite growing into huge activations, push toward recast Rocco X payments, but ramp only supports the engine.

tags.name: blink
tags.reason: Norin the Wary and Saltskitter flicker themselves; the deck plays no blink spells.

tags.name: chaos
tags.reason: Confusion in the Ranks and Chaos Warp add swing, but Confusion is played as a targeted steal engine with Norin.

tags.name: theft
tags.reason: Confusion in the Ranks with Norin trades him for an opponent's best creature, and Norin comes home at end step anyway.
